description: Built-in NPDev workspace tables: navigation Menus (internal NPDev UI, business UIs, and hand-authored companion pages) and the scoped-property cascade's storage (PropertyValue -- one row per (scopeType, scopeId, propKey), row PRESENCE is the is-set signal against the declared properties[]/propertyScopes[] cascade; see RC-A3's PropertyResolver). Generic by design so they can evolve with system maturity. userId / parentMenuId / requiredRole are soft references (plain strings) to the identity pack and to other menus; they harden into bonds when the built-in packs compose into an app. Menu.kind: INTERNAL targets a fixed platform surface (preferences/store/boxview/promotion), BUSINESS targets a concept or declared Panel by name, PAGE targets a literal relative URL to a hand-authored static page, GROUP is a non-navigable label node whose children (via parentMenuId) form a submenu -- its target is unused and seeds as an empty string.
author: NPDev
